evidence.claim: Daiki Sound provides worldwide digital distribution, CD/DVD distribution through a nationwide retail network, and karaoke distribution including JOYSOUND and Karaoke no Tetsujin.
Daiki Sound's official material states that download-store prices can be selected by the artist/label and gives Japan iTunes reference prices and minimum sales amounts.
Bandcamp charges 15% on digital items and 10% on physical goods; the digital fee drops to 10% after $5,000 in sales, with payment processor fees separate.

SoundCloud for Artists states that distribution to Spotify, Apple Music, TikTok and 50+ platforms can retain 100% of royalties, and also offers fan-powered royalties, direct fan contributions, merch and vinyl links.

YouTube Partner Program supports advertising, memberships, Super Chat, Super Thanks, Shopping and YouTube Premium revenue; the current help page states 55% of net revenue for watch-page ads and 70% for fan-funding features under the relevant modules.
YouTube Content ID matches uploaded videos against reference files and can apply monetization, tracking or blocking policies when the rights holder is eligible and owns the required exclusive rights.

Stripe Payment Links lets creators sell products, subscriptions and donations without a website, share a payment URL, and receive funds in a bank account; the Japan page lists 3.6% per successful card payment.
